summary: Vivmark Residential (formerly Equity Residential) filed an 8-K on November 4, 2026, furnishing Q3 2026 results and updated Q4/FY guidance via press release and supplemental package, signed by CFO Kevin O'Shea. The release highlights operating results ahead of plan and increased synergy expectations in the company's first quarter under the Vivmark name. Despite the 2.01 item tag, the text reflects no asset acquisition or disposition terms. No transaction price, stake, premium, advisor, board recommendation or regulatory clock is stated. Watch for future disclosure on capital allocation; no deal-arb angle exists.
